text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Today's photo shoot really
dragged on. I
missed my chance to eat
back at the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(This is happening a lot lately. The only
proper
meal I had today was lunch. I've
gotta do
something before my body
reaps the
consequences.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Oh wait, I can just pack my own food. I
won't
have to skip any meals if I bring
food with me to
my shoots. Good
thinking, me!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not again! How are these eggs
going from
raw to burnt without any
warning?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe deciding to make my own meals
all of a
sudden was a little too
ambitious...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Welp, I guess this will have to do.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (I knew this was going to taste bad, but this is bad bad. This stuff's still half-raw while this stuff's half-burnt... This sucks...)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
City, we're going to be starting again in
five!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oops. Okay! Coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Gold City at the park, on set for a
shoot.
She doesn't look all too well,
though, so I stick
around to watch over
her, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (...Ugh, I feel a stomachache coming on.)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
You look great, City! Now, if you would
just look
straight at the camera...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Nope. I can tough this one out... I hope.
I just
need to focus on the camera.)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: And that's a wrap. Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, are you all right? You look a little
pale.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What? No, yeah, I'm fine. The makeup
artist
probably just used a foundation
that's too blue
for me.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure that's why? You're
sweating, and I
could tell you weren't
totally focused during the
shoot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Nothing gets past you, does it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just have a little stomachache. It's
nothing
serious. Lunch wasn't the tastiest
thing in the
world today, that's all.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did you make your own lunch?
Why would
you push yourself like that
when you're already
stretched so thin?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Just let me handle all your meals. You
should
really count on me more for these
things.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's food back at the dorm, so I'll be
fine.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: I think it's pretty clear that you're not fine... I know a good restaurant that serves nourishing meals. We can go there after this.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I think they offer take-out too, so I'll
have them
deliver meals to you from now
o—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Quit that already! You coddle me too
much!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Geez, why does she like to baby me
so much?
But then again, I'm the one
who messed up here.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I was the one who decided to pursue
both
modeling and racing, so it's my
fault that I'm
always so busy and don't
have time to eat.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I've got to get my act together... This is
my
problem to solve.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Guess I should stop by a bookstore so I
can buy a
cookbook and learn the basics
of cooking...
